definitions.explanation: The fee or expense for textbooks, workbooks, and other materials used in educational courses or training programs.

examples.japanese: {教材費|きょうざいひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別途|べっと}→別途：11881_betto⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Teaching material costs are charged separately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{教材費|きょうざいひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: The tuition includes the cost of materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教材費|きょうざいひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Complaints arose from parents because the annual cost of teaching materials was high.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly appears in school and course fee breakdowns. Often listed alongside tuition (⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧) and other fees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教材費|きょうざいひ}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ (including materials cost)
- {教材費|きょうざいひ}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (materials cost separate)
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{教材費|きょうざいひ} (annual materials cost)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧: tuition — the fee for the classes themselves
- ⟦{教材|きょうざい}→教材：12878_kyouzai⟧: teaching materials — the materials without reference to cost
